new.s: Who is the Sports Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Mandipalli Ramprasad Reddy is the Sports Minister; Kandula Durgesh holds Tourism.

new.s: Vempaty Kutumba Sastry's Padma Shri 2026 was in which category?
new.x: Vempaty Kutumba Sastry's Padma Shri was for literature and education; Nori Dattatreyudu's Padma Bhushan was for medicine.

new.s: Within how long is the Centre's 12-member committee on AP–Telangana water disputes to report?
new.x: The committee has to report in three months, on 10 agenda items.

new.s: The Pasarlapudi gas blowout of 8 January 1995 kept burning for about:
new.x: The Pasarlapudi fire lasted 65 days and was capped by ONGC's own team on 15 March 1995.

new.s: Which district was adjudged the Best Swachha District at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025?
new.x: Anantapur was the Best Swachha District 2025; Tadipatri won among municipalities.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh received the Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman Best State Award at the Central Silk Board's 76th Foundation Day in:
new.x: It was presented at the 76th Foundation Day of the CSB in Bengaluru on 20 September 2025.

new.s: Which AP department won the Best Tableau award on Independence Day 2025?
new.x: The AP Sericulture Department won the Best Tableau on Independence Day 2025.

new.s: Prasad Suri won the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2025 (Telugu) for:
new.x: Prasad Suri won the Yuva Puraskar for the novel Mairaavana; Kaburla Devatha won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar.

new.s: Gangisetti Sivakumar's 'Kaburla Devatha' won which Sahitya Akademi award in 2025?
new.x: Kaburla Devatha (stories) won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025.

new.s: How many teachers nationwide received the National Best Teacher Award 2025?
new.x: 45 teachers got the award; M. Thirumala Sridevi was the only one from AP.

new.s: How many persons received the Kalaratna (Hamsa) award at the Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025?
new.x: 86 got the Kalaratna (Hamsa) and 121 the Ugadi Puraskar – 207 in all.

new.s: Each Ugadi Puraskar 2025 awardee received a cash award of:
new.x: The Ugadi Puraskar carries ₹10,000; the Kalaratna (Hamsa) carries ₹50,000.

new.s: The Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025 were organised by the Endowments Department and the:
o: AP State Creativity and Culture Commission
new.x: They were organised by the AP State Creativity and Culture Commission and the Endowments Department.

new.s: Jyothi Yarraji won gold at the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships, Gumi, in:
new.x: She won the women's 100 m hurdles in 12.96 s, a championship record, retaining her 2023 title.

new.s: Jyothi Yarraji of Visakhapatnam received which national sports award in 2024?
new.x: Jyothi Yarraji is an Arjuna Award (2024) recipient.

new.s: Juitha Guna of Rajamahendravaram won gold in the 69 kg Youth category at the Commonwealth Championship 2025 in:
new.x: She won gold at the Commonwealth Weightlifting Championship 2025, Ahmedabad.

new.s: The Asian Schools Chess Championship 2025, where AP players won 3 of India's 8 medals, was held at:
new.x: It was held at Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about para-swimmer Balaga Ganesh:
1. He crossed the Palk Strait solo.
2. He crossed the English Channel solo.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Palk Strait swim was solo, but the English Channel crossing was a six-member relay.

new.s: Which district ranked No. 1 in the Yogandhra rankings with 8 lakh+ people at 5,050 locations?
new.x: Annamayya district was No. 1, with its main event at Rayachoti.

new.s: In the National Sports Awards 2025, how many Arjuna awards were given?
new.x: Only 17 Arjuna awards were given, none to an AP athlete, and no Khel Ratna was given.

new.s: How many sports are covered under Andhra Pradesh's 3% sports quota?
new.x: The 3% sports quota covers 65 sports in two disciplines, verified by SAAP.

new.s: Under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29, a Sports City is planned at:
new.x: The Sports City is planned in Amaravati; there is no sports capital at Kakinada.

new.s: Usha Vance, wife of US Vice President JD Vance, has her ancestral village at:
new.x: Usha Vance (née Chilukuri) has her ancestral village at Vadluru near Tanuku, West Godavari.

new.s: Which Minister of the AP social-media Group of Ministers holds Housing and I&PR?
new.x: Kolusu Parthasarathy holds Housing and I&PR.

new.s: Justice Subhendu Samanta took his oath as an Andhra Pradesh High Court judge on 29 October 2025 before:
new.x: The oath was administered by AP HC Chief Justice Dhiraj Singh Thakur in the First Court Hall.

new.s: Erra Matti Dibbalu were formed during the Last Glacial Maximum, about:
new.x: The red sand hills formed during the Last Glacial Maximum, about 18,500 years ago.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's tableau 'Hear the Beat of Indian Cinema and Tourism' won first prize at the 56th IFFI held in:
new.x: The 56th IFFI was held at Panaji, Goa, on 20–28 November 2025.

new.s: The Vijayawada Dasara Carnival of 2 October 2025 set a Guinness World Record for the largest number of:
new.x: Over 1,000 drummers set the record for the largest number of drum artists performing together.

new.s: Which flower was the State symbol of undivided Andhra Pradesh, before residual AP adopted Jasmine?
new.x: The Water Lily (and the Indian Roller bird) were old united-AP symbols; residual AP's flower is Jasmine.

new.s: Kanneganti Hanumanthu is associated with the:
new.x: Kanneganti Hanumanthu led the Pullari Satyagraha in Palnadu against forest taxes.

new.s: CESCT, Nellore functions under the:
new.x: The Centre of Excellence for Studies in Classical Telugu functions under CIIL, Mysuru.

new.s: Etikoppaka toys, shown at the 44th IITF 2025, are made from which wood?
new.x: Etikoppaka toys of Anakapalli district are made of Ankudu wood; GI tag 2017.

new.s: Etikoppaka village, known for its GI-tagged toys, lies on which river?
new.x: Etikoppaka lies on the Varaha river in Anakapalli district.

new.s: Under GST 2.0, the GST on handicrafts such as Kondapalli and Etikoppaka toys was cut from 12% to:
new.x: Handicrafts moved from 12% to 5% under GST 2.0.

new.s: The 44th India International Trade Fair 2025 was held at:
new.x: The 44th IITF opened on 14 November 2025 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

new.s: What is the IUCN status of the striped dolphin sighted off Visakhapatnam?
new.x: The striped dolphin is Least Concern; all cetaceans are in Schedule I of WPA 1972.

new.s: The mango covers given by the Chittoor Horticulture Department cost farmers, after subsidy:
new.x: The covers cost ₹2 in the market; the Horticulture Department gives them at ₹1.

new.s: Under the Swachh Ratham pilot, the dry waste collected from villagers is:
new.x: The waste is sold to recyclers, not used for biogas.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the removal of a High Court judge:
1. The removal motion must be signed by at least 100 Lok Sabha members if moved there.
2. The Constitution uses the word 'impeachment' for judges.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: A removal motion needs 100 Lok Sabha or 50 Rajya Sabha members; the Constitution does not use the word 'impeachment' for judges.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Kangundi village?
o: It is known for Neolithic cave art
It has temples of the Chola, Hoysala and Vijayanagara periods
It lies at the tri-junction of AP, Karnataka and Telangana
An AP Sports Climbing Hub is planned there
new.x: Kangundi lies at the tri-junction of AP, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, not Telangana.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the January 2026 Konaseema gas blowout:
1. The site was operated by ONGC.
2. The area was declared a danger zone for 24 hours.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: ONGC operated the site and the area was declared a danger zone for 24 hours.

new.s: Which of the following event–venue pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: WAPCON–2026 was at Andhra University; SATTE was in New Delhi, the Sammelan at NSU Tirupati and the Flamingo Festival at Nelapattu.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about organ donation under Jeevan Daan?
o: 301 organs were donated by 93 brain-dead donors in 2025
The 2025 figure is the highest since bifurcation
new.x: THOTA, 1994 was amended in 2011, not 2004.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP's Group of Ministers on social media?
o: Its convenor is the Commissioner/Director of I&PR
The central law on the subject is the IT Act, 2000
It has powers to enforce penalties on platforms
new.x: The GoM only recommends; it has no enforcement powers.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about DRDO:
1. It was established in 1958 under the Ministry of Defence.
2. It led Mission Shakti, India's first ASAT test.
3. A major DRDO laboratory is headquartered in Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; no major DRDO lab is headquartered in AP, which has only test facilities and collaborations.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about teacher Siviku Bangarayya?
o: He teaches at Jarjapupeta village, Vizianagaram district
His awards came from All The Best Academy, Hyderabad
He was honoured for free coaching to the underprivileged
His Guru Brahma Award is an AP government award
new.x: The awards came from All The Best Academy, Hyderabad; they are not AP government awards.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's GST collections in August 2025:
1. They rose by 21%.
2. They amounted to ₹3,989 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: AP's GST collections rose 21% to ₹3,989 crore in August 2025.
